missions.objective: Fix task lookup for old JSON databases containing null, string, integer or dictionaries without id. Skip them without changing the list. Return the original position of the first dictionary with the requested id, or None if absent. Keep the exact signature.
missions.test:
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/scratch") as folder:
    db = Path(folder) / "tasks.json"
    original = [None, "old", 17, {"title": "legacy"}, {"id": "ok", "title": "before", "done": False}, {"id": "ok", "title": "later"}]
    db.write_text(json.dumps(original), encoding="utf-8")
    cli = [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/work/program.py", "--db", str(db)]
    edited = subprocess.run([*cli, "edit", "ok", "after"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    assert edited.returncode == 0  # case: skip-invalid-entries-on-edit
    assert json.loads(edited.stdout)["title"] == "after"  # case: edit-first-match
    assert json.loads(db.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) == [*original[:4], {**original[4], "title": "after"}, original[5]]  # case: preserve-order-and-duplicates
    missing = subprocess.run([*cli, "delete", "missing"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    assert missing.returncode == 1 and json.loads(missing.stdout)["error"] == "Task not found"  # case: absent-id

missions.objective: Treat a queue JSON file with invalid UTF-8 as an unreadable envelope. Return a nonempty list of human-readable validation errors instead of raising UnicodeDecodeError. Preserve handling of valid UTF-8, malformed JSON and missing files. Keep the exact signature.
missions.test:
import json, subprocess, sys
child = 'import json, runpy, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
scope = runpy.run_path("/work/program.py")
f = scope["validate_file"]
envelope = scope["Envelope"].create(origin=scope["Actor"]("human", "fixture"), kind="heartbeat")
def read(path):
    try:
        problems = f(path)
        return [isinstance(problems, list), len(problems), all(isinstance(p, str) and bool(p) for p in problems)]
    except Exception as exc:
        return {"error": type(exc).__name__}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir="/scratch") as folder:
    path = Path(folder) / "envelope.json"
    missing = read(path)
    path.write_bytes(bytes([255]))
    invalid_utf8 = read(path)
    path.write_text("{", encoding="utf-8")
    invalid_json = read(path)
    path.write_text(envelope.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
    valid = read(path)
print(json.dumps([missing, invalid_utf8, invalid_json, valid]))
'
run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '-c', child], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=6)
